jobPostingInfo.title: Software Engineer, Backend
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
As a Junior Systems Engineer at NXP, you will contribute to the design, development, integration, and validation of semiconductor-based systems and solutions. Working within multidisciplinary engineering teams, you will support the definition of system requirements, interfaces, and specifications to ensure effective hardware and software integration. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop technical expertise while participating in the end-to-end product development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development and documentation of system requirements, architectures, and technical specifications for semiconductor products and solutions.
  • Assist in defining system interfaces, functional behavior, and input/output parameters for hardware and software components.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze customer, business, and technical requirements and translate them into system-level solutions.
  • Participate in system modeling, simulation, prototyping, integration, testing, and validation activities.
